rows.behavior: The plugin declares exactly one hook, a SessionStart hook that runs kmctl briefing.
rows.fails_when: plugin/hooks/hooks.json has any event other than SessionStart, more than one hook, or a command that does not run kmctl briefing

rows.behavior: Without kmctl on PATH, the hook exits 0 and prints how to install kmctl.
rows.fails_when: the hook command, run with a PATH that has no kmctl, exits nonzero or prints no install hint

rows.behavior: The marketplace entry declares okf from marketplace scaccogatto and allowlists scaccogatto.
rows.fails_when: marketplace.json lacks the okf dependency with marketplace scaccogatto, or allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn does not include scaccogatto

rows.behavior: claude plugin validate accepts the plugin and the marketplace.
rows.fails_when: claude plugin validate reports an error for plugin/ or the root marketplace
